summary: Re-test iter54bis: all HIGH/MEDIUM bugs from iter54 are FIXED. Backend 5/5 pytest passing (rides/estimate + new phase2/runner/book + /runner/my). Frontend full-flow verified on mobile viewport after email/password login via /api/auth/login: TaxiBiddingPage testids & prefill now render, estimate banner shows with suggested fare, submit navigates to /ride/{id}. RunnerPage testids present. UserHome 'Enchères VTC' navigates to /taxi-bidding and 'Électricien' navigates to /services-bidding?cat=bcat_electric.

issues: Still no visible email-login entry point in 'autre option' sheet — testing agents must authenticate via POST /api/auth/login. Not a new regression but worth revisiting for UX/testability.

critical_code_review_comments: Multiple Google Maps script loads detected in console: 'You have included the Google Maps JavaScript API multiple times on this page.' Happens when pages mount GooglePlacesInput multiple times and user navigates between pages. Loader in /app/frontend/src/components/GooglePlacesInput.js guards scriptLoaded but the warning still comes from google.maps auto-loading custom elements. Minor / non-blocking.
google.maps.places.Autocomplete is deprecated for new customers since March 2025. Existing integrations continue to work, but long-term consider migrating to PlaceAutocompleteElement.
WebSocket to /ws/user_<id> fails on taxi-bidding page (connection closed before establishment). Not in scope of this iteration but should be tracked.
test_credentials: test2@example.com / TestPass123! — logged in via POST /api/auth/login; cookies persist in browser context for subsequent page.goto
seed_data_creation: Created ~3 TEST runner orders in db.runner_orders for test2 user during pytest (via /api/phase2/runner/book).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter54 HIGH/MEDIUM bugs fixed and verified end-to-end. Verified items: (1) GooglePlacesInput now forwards testId prop and respects `value`; (2) fare picker always rendered with fare-input/fare-plus/fare-minus testids; (3) pickup-input/dropoff-input/runner-pickup/runner-drop testids present; (4) /taxi-bidding prefill via query params visibly populates inputs; (5) /api/rides/estimate 200 OK with full payload (pickup_address/dropoff_address/payment_method); (6) TaxiBiddingPage submit navigates to /ride/{ride.id} (not /ride-tracking/); (7) /api/phase2/runner/book 200 OK for simple and multiple modes; (8) 'Enchères VTC' card -> /taxi-bidding; (9) 'Électricien' card -> /services-bidding?cat=bcat_electric with query string preserved. Not tested: /ride open-taxi-bidding-btn and request-now-btn because these are conditional on pickup+dropoff+vehicle selection — not covered in this run but code path is correct per spec.
rca of the issue: N/A — all previously reported bugs already resolved by main agent's fixes (GooglePlacesInput controlled component with testId forwarding, always-rendered fare picker, corrected /rides/estimate payload with pickup_address/dropoff_address/payment_method, navigate('/ride/${id}'), bidServices using s.path, new /api/phase2/runner/book endpoint).
